messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile 3D paper-folding puzzle adventure titled **THE LAST FOLD** for the existing repo, which previously contained only scaffold files because the prior session failed before writing any game code.

## Requirements
- Core fold mechanic: swipe to create a crease; drag a side over; objects/player move with folded paper; overlapping surfaces form bridges.
- Third-person isometric 3D camera, mobile-friendly touch controls.
- Main menu, tutorial, at least 10 playable levels, restart, level progression, sound effects, unlockable skins/environments, hidden golden origami stars.
- 5 worlds: Paper Forest, Frozen Origami, The Forgotten City, Floating Islands, Cosmic Paper World.
- Prioritize smooth performance on Android.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) for self-checks and read only the latest image.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them at finish.

## Decisions
- Built as static HTML/CSS/JS with vendored Three.js r160 (`js/three.module.js`) and vendored fonts; no `package.json` because the runtime's `projectType()` rejects non-Vite package projects.
- Fold model: fold side across a grid-aligned crease, mirror + merge floor/wall, clear folded side, move player/goal/stars/enemies, remove player/goal if invalid, clear folded half. Opposing side must fit (`foldedLen <= otherLen`).
- Gesture mapping: press cell + swipe direction determines crease; the page opposite the swipe direction folds; drag distance drives live fold progress; release > ~45% completes.
- Camera is near-top-down 3D at 58° elevation so world X/Z map cleanly to horizontal/vertical swipes.
- Level progression: 10 handcrafted levels, 3-star scoring per level (completion / all golden stars / folds ≤ par), skins unlock at 0/6/14/24 total stars, localStorage save.
- Enemies are patrolling ink blobs; their patrol routes mirror/disappear when folded.
- Sound is fully procedural WebAudio; no external audio assets.
- Graphics auto/lite/high setting; auto should detect software renderers and fall back to lite.

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified all 10 level grids with a solver: every level has no zero-fold solution, goal and all-stars solvable, and all-stars within par.
- Wrote `js/levels.js` with worlds, palettes, level data, fold rules, save helpers, skins.
- Wrote `tools/validate-levels.mjs`; all levels currently report `OK` and `All levels valid.`
- Wrote `js/audio.js` with procedural SFX/ambient engine.
- Wrote `js/world.js` with Three.js diorama, materials, tiles, props, player/enemy/goal/star meshes, camera fit, fold pivot animation, menu diorama, particles.
- Wrote `index.html` with boot, menu, levels, skins, settings, game HUD, pause/win/confirm modals, world intro, toast, veil, SVG icon sprite.
- Wrote `css/style.css` covering all screens, responsive/mobile layout, paper styling, buttons, level thumbnails, skins, HUD, modals.
- Downloaded fonts: `assets/fonts/fraunces.woff2`, `assets/fonts/manrope.woff2`.
- Downloaded and vendored Three.js to `js/three.module.js`.

### Active
- Need to implement `js/game.js` and `js/main.js` (bootstrap) — not yet written.
- Need to wire UI events, screen transitions, save/load, level starting, tap-to-move, gesture folding, undo/restart, enemy patrol/collision, star collection, win/unlock flow, skin/settings behavior.
- Need to patch any remaining `world.js` issues after runtime testing.
- Need to run the app and screenshot-test desktop and mobile.

### Blocked
- Game currently cannot start because `js/main.js` does not exist and `index.html` references it.
- No server started yet for visual testing.

## Next Move
1. Create `js/game.js` implementing `Game` orchestration (UI, saves, input, tweens, level lifecycle, win/undo/restart, enemy collision, skins/settings).
2. Create `js/main.js` that instantiates the game, loads fonts/save, hides boot, starts animation loop.
3. Patch `world.js` issues discovered during review:
   - `beginFold()` now attaches stars/goal to pivot (already patched).
   - `clearLevel()` now disposes player materials and uses `disposePlayer()` (already patched).
   - Menu now calls `buildMenuSun(theme, true)` (already patched).
   - Verify `buildMenu()` cell positioning and menu camera composition.
4. Serve locally on port 3002 via `PORT=3002 RUNTIME_DIR=... ./start.sh` in tmux/background.
5. Use Playwright to inspect: boot/menu, level 1, fold gesture, win modal, level select, skins, settings, mobile 390×844; capture small JPEGs to `screenshots/latest.jpg` and read only the latest.
6. Fix visual/functional bugs, re-run validate script, then finish with assumptions noted.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: complete DOM/UI shell; references missing `js/main.js`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/levels.js`: level data, fold state logic, world palettes, skins, save helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/world.js`: Three.js scene/diorama/fold visuals/menu scene; needs runtime verification.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: `AudioEngine` procedural sound.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: full responsive UI styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/three.module.js`: vendored Three.js r160.

- Current validated level outcomes: L1–L6, L9 need 1 fold; L7, L8, L10 need 2 folds; pars are 1 for L1–L6/L9 and 2 for L7/L8/L10; L10 has 2 stars, others 1.
- Level IDs/worlds: 1 First Crease + 2 Upward (Forest); 3 Bridging the Gap + 4 Icebound (Frozen); 5 Rooftop Relay + 6 Ink Patrol (City); 7 Skyward + 8 Cloudfold (Floating); 9 The Moving Door + 10 The Last Fold (Cosmic).
- `world.js` exports `CELL = 1.22`; game must use `world.worldX()`, `world.worldZ()`, `world.creaseWorldX(k)`, `world.cellFromWorld(point)`, `world.screenToGround(clientX, clientY)`.
- Fold axes use `'x'` for vertical crease/boundary between x cells and `'z'` for horizontal crease; `side < 0` means left/top flap, `side > 0` right/bottom.
- `foldPlan(state, axis, k, side)` returns `{ok:true,state,sources,foldedLen,otherLen}` or `{ok:false,reason}`; reasons include `too-wide`, `player-drops`, `goal-drops`, `overhang`, `empty`.
- `world.beginFold(plan, state, axis, k, side)`, `setFoldProgress(progress, axis, side)`, `cancelFoldProgress()`, `endFold()`, `updateStarCollection(key, cb)`, `burst(x,z,color,count,y)`, `winBurst(x,z,theme)`, `updateEnemyTargets(state)`.
- `world.buildLevel(state, def, skin, theme, {animateEntry})`, `world.buildMenu(theme, skin, save, progress)`, `world.setQuality('auto'|'high'|'lite')`, `world.setReducedMotion(bool)`, `world.setTheme(theme)`, `world.resize()`, `world.update(dt,time)`, `world.render()`, `world.getRendererInfo()`.
- `world.js` has `this.playerParts` never assigned after `buildPlayer`; fix in buildLevel/buildMenu if idle animation is needed.
- `buildPlayer` creates unique materials and `clearLevel()` now calls `disposePlayer()`.
- Preserve user-facing polished visual style; use the CSS classes already defined rather than inventing new UI patterns.
- Runtime screenshot instruction: save `.jpg` at viewport ≤1280 wide; read only latest image; full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
- `capture.sh`/`start.sh` rely on `RUNTIME_DIR`; server default port is `process.env.PORT || 3000`, previous docs mention port `3002`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile 3D paper-folding puzzle adventure titled **THE LAST FOLD** in the existing static HTML/CSS/JS repo.

## Requirements
- Core fold mechanic: swipe to create a crease; drag a side over; player/objects move with folded paper; overlapping surfaces form bridges.
- Third-person isometric 3D camera, mobile-friendly touch controls.
- Main menu, tutorial, at least 10 playable levels, restart, progression, sound effects, unlockable skins/environments, hidden golden origami stars.
- 5 worlds: Paper Forest, Frozen Origami, The Forgotten City, Floating Islands, Cosmic Paper World.
- Prioritize smooth performance on Android.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) for self-checks and read only the latest image.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them at finish.

## Decisions
- Static site with vendored Three.js r160 and fonts; no `package.json` because runtime `projectType()` rejects non-Vite package projects.
- Fold model: fold flap across a grid-aligned crease, mirror/merge terrain, clear folded side, move player/goal/stars/enemies, reject invalid folds (`too-wide`, `player-drops`, `goal-drops`, etc.).
- Gesture mapping: crease is at the pressed cell’s leading edge; page opposite swipe direction folds; drag distance drives live fold progress; release ≥45% completes.
- Camera near-top-down (58° elevation); world X/Z map cleanly to horizontal/vertical swipes.
- 10 handcrafted levels, 3-star scoring (completion / all golden stars / folds ≤ par), skins unlock at 0/6/14/24 stars, localStorage save.
- Enemies are patrolling ink blobs; patrol routes mirror/disappear on folds; touching one resets the current page.
- Procedural WebAudio SFX/ambient; no external audio assets.
- Graphics auto/lite/high; auto detects software renderers and falls back to lite.
- Visual polish decisions: fold includes a backing paper sheet; stars oscillate rather than spin edge-on; glow intensity reduced; player enlarged slightly; gesture hint moved to top; `#ui` and overlays fixed for pointer input.

## Work State
### Completed
- `js/levels.js` level data, fold rules, worlds, skins, save helpers; validated all 10 levels.
- `js/audio.js` procedural SFX/ambient engine.
- `js/world.js` Three.js diorama, fold visuals, menu scene, particles, enemies, quality/theme settings.
- `index.html` and `css/style.css` complete UI shell and responsive styling.
- Vendored `js/three.module.js` and `assets/fonts/{fraunces,manrope}.woff2`.
- Implemented `js/game.js`: screens, saves, level lifecycle, tap-to-move, swipe folds, undo/restart, enemies, stars, win/unlocks, skins, settings, pause, reset.
- Implemented `js/main.js` bootstrap with font wait, WebGL error handling, boot removal, animation loop.
- Fixed pointer blocking by setting `#ui { pointer-events: none; }`, `.overlay.open { pointer-events: auto; }`, and adding disabled button styling.
- Fixed fold pivot removal/restoration (`disposePivot(restore)`, `endFold(restore)`), x-axis fold rotation sign, and playerParts assignment.
- Verified desktop/mobile layouts, level start, live fold, completion/win modal, undo, pause, settings-from-pause, and mobile level atlas via Playwright with no runtime errors.
- Verified L1 fold→walk→win and L2 swipe-up hint path collecting its golden star and earning all 3 stars.
- Node simulation confirms validated solution paths for all 10 levels can collect all stars and reach the goal without premature win.

### Active
- Final visual/functional review of remaining levels and menus.
- Test skins selection/unlock, settings toggles/reset, level progression, and enemy collision behavior.
- Re-run validation/syntax checks after final patches.
- Capture final screenshots and finish with assumptions noted.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run a full all-level runtime smoke test via `js/game.js` APIs or real gestures, checking `won`, star counts, and level/skin unlock state.
2. Test skin selection, reset progress, sound/motion/quality settings, and enemy patrol/collision.
3. Re-check desktop (1280×800) and mobile (390×844) screenshots for regressions, especially fold animation and HUD.
4. Re-run `node --experimental-default-type=module tools/validate-levels.mjs` and syntax checks.
5. Note assumptions/limitations at finish; working tree remains uncommitted unless requested.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: main orchestration, input, saves, UI, gameplay.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/world.js`: Three.js scene, fold animation, dioramas.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/levels.js`: level data, fold rules, save/skin helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: bootstrap and render-loop startup.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: procedural audio engine.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM/UI shell.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: responsive UI and visual styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/tools/validate-levels.mjs`: exhaustive fold/star solver.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: runtime static server entry.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/latest.jpg`: latest self-check screenshot.

## Important Context
- Local server currently running on `PORT=3002` via `PORT=3002 RUNTIME_DIR="$RUNTIME_DIR" ./start.sh`.
- Validation command: `node --experimental-default-type=module tools/validate-levels.mjs`; reports all levels valid.
- Syntax check command: `node --experimental-default-type=module --check <file>`.
- Playwright installed at `/tmp/opencode/pw` using `playwright-core@1.51.1` and `/usr/bin/chromium`; test scripts live there (`play.mjs`, `tour.mjs`, `mechanics.mjs`, `level2b.mjs`, etc.).
- Headless SwiftShader selects `lite` quality; low FPS means tests need generous waits (up to ~3s) for walk/win timers.
- L2 hint path is swipe **up** from player `(4,4)` (`z4+`), not the validated alternate `z3-`; the hint path collects the star and earns 3 stars.
- Current level solutions/stars: L1–L6 and L9 need 1 fold; L7, L8, L10 need 2 folds; pars match; L10 has 2 stars.
- Level order: 1 First Crease, 2 Upward, 3 Bridging the Gap, 4 Icebound, 5 Rooftop Relay, 6 Ink Patrol, 7 Skyward, 8 Cloudfold, 9 The Moving Door, 10 The Last Fold.
- `world.js` exports `CELL = 1.22`; key APIs: `worldX`, `worldZ`, `creaseWorldX/Z`, `cellFromWorld`, `screenToGround`, `buildLevel`, `buildMenu`, `beginFold`, `setFoldProgress`, `cancelFoldProgress`, `endFold(restore)`, `updateStarCollection`, `burst`, `winBurst`, `updateEnemyTargets`, `setQuality`, `setReducedMotion`, `setTheme`, `resize`, `update`, `render`, `getRendererInfo`.
- `foldPlan()` returns `{ok,state,sources,foldedLen,otherLen,collectedStar}` or `{ok:false,reason}`.
- Save key is `the-last-fold.save.v1`; total possible stars is 30.
- Working tree changes are uncommitted; repo started at commit `a1174de`.
